reviews.comment: Consensus from most people I spoke to is that they regret taking this course, even if the grade earned was alright. She's pretty condescending and strict. No electronics allowed, physical copies only. You will not know your grades or have lecture slides online. To do well, have welding experience or be prepared to grind really hard. Frustrating.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Good choice for MMET207, she is on the academic dishonesty board, is strict but absolutely fair. Lab isn't bad, lectures were a bit packed but we lost a week to the snow storm. Definitely a lot to absorb so take good notes and don't just copy whats on the slides. Only thing I didn't like was the 0 grade for late labs so do em early, i forgot 1.

Angie Price is a solid choice for 207. Yes, she doesn't always post grades on time but who does? She gives just enough extra credit to put you where you'd like to be grade-wise. She also cares about her students. She WILL work with you so that you dont feel the need to drop this class. IF you put in the work you WILL pass this class.

Professor Price lacks communication. Students can send her multiple emails and never get a response. She also doesnt post your course grade and doesnt tell you your test/assignment grades for weeks making it hard to know if you need to drop. Even with 2 days left to Q-drop, I still dont know my grade in the course. Also doesnt record lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy
